photos.desc: Buglossoides arvensis near Horselake, Chelan County Washington
Introduced, cool season, annual, erect, hairy herb to 45 cm tall. Stems have few to many and ascending. branches. Leaves are opposite, becoming alternate along the stems, sessile, narrow-oblanceolate
